Here is the start of our documentation, and me planning out the entire game in detail! I've had many thoughts up to this point, but now they'll be organized

Complete Documentation; Project Voidmarch

Introduction:



The User Experience throughout the game - Game Loop:

The User, from now on referred to as the Player; will spawn into the game in the manned spacecraft-like satellite hereafter referred to as The Communication Satellite. Shortly before this the Player witnesses a cutscene played through a series of pixel art paintings. This cutscene will go through the pregame lore that goes like this;

“Enemy forces of mainly turtles, led by an evil enemy turtle, Gert. Have almost completely taken over the planet, Tellus 2. The people that earlier inhabited the planet have been captured and taken hostage in different places on the planet. Many find this is the end of mankind. But can one person change it all?”

At this point in the cutscene the Player harshly gets interrupted by blinking red lights and swiftly becomes drawn into the main game. The reason that it’s blinking red and alarms are sounding? Well, The Communication Satellites alarms are ringing, because the Player has escaped their cell. Well, they haven’t had control over that part, but are thrown into the situation of being attacked. 
It is important to address that the first encounter with the game is actually leaning towards a tutorial level. Throughout The Communication Satellite- Level, there will be easy to understand ‘User Interface’ type instructions on top of the level, as you fight your first enemies. These will be things like jumping, attacking, eventual character special abilities and so on.

By the end of this level, the player will not only have learnt about the basic mechanics needed to progress into the more in depth levels found further in the game; but have done so in a way that feels a part of the game, and is also an important puzzle piece in the overarching story, the taking down of the Communication Satellite. The effect of this will be further discussed further in the documentation.
